subject: MAP: Redwood Inference x Zenwell — Draft & timeline options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Caroline Hughes <caroline.hughes@zenwell.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Redwood Inference x Zenwell — Draft & timeline options

Hi Caroline —

Thanks again for the productive discovery this morning. As promised, I put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft to capture milestones, owners, dependencies, and a couple of timeline options so we can align on next steps. Please find the draft attached (Zenwell_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx).

High-level ask: can you confirm the list of stakeholders we should include and whether the Preferred Close target (Option A below) looks reasonable?

Summary (from today's call):
- Primary use case: inference at scale for patient triage + structured output for EHR ingestion
- Success metrics: sub-300ms p95 gen latency, <= $0.004/token, integrated audit logs & retention policy
- Key blockers: procurement approval, SOC2 evidence pack, internal technical deep dive

Draft milestones & responsibilities (see attached for full table):
1) Technical deep dive (1 week) — Owner: Zenwell (CTO) + Redwood SE (Aditya) — Deliverable: integration checklist + sample queries
2) Security review & evidence handoff (2 weeks) — Owner: Zenwell Security + Redwood Security — Deliverable: SOC2 report, data handling docs
3) Procurement & commercial review (2-3 weeks) — Owner: Zenwell Procurement + Redwood Sales (me) — Deliverable: final SOW and T&Cs
4) Pilot deployment & validation (3-4 weeks) — Owner: Zenwell Eng + Redwood Ops — Deliverable: production-like pilot with metrics

Timeline options (target close = contract signed):
- Option A (accelerated): Target close 2026-08-21 — assumes tech deep dive this week and procurement prioritizes
- Option B (baseline): Target close 2026-09-15 — more conservative to allow additional procurement cycles

Please reply with:
1) Stakeholder confirmation (names + emails) to include on the MAP
2) Preferred timeline (Option A or B) or an alternate proposed close date
3) Any additional dependencies we missed

Next steps from our side: Aditya will schedule the technical deep dive once stakeholders are confirmed; Laura will prep the CS kickoff and pilot success criteria.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Zenwell_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet — milestones, owners, dates)

Subject: Re: MAP: Redwood Inference x Zenwell — Draft & timeline options

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the follow-up and the clear MAP draft — this is very helpful. On stakeholders, please include:
- Caroline Hughes (me) — Director, Product (caroline.hughes@zenwell.com)
- Michael Zhao — CTO (michael.zhao@zenwell.com)
- Priya Mehra — Procurement Lead (pmehra@zenwell.com)
- Aaron Lee — Lead Engineer (aaron.lee@zenwell.com) — I'll ask him to join the tech deep dive

We prefer Option B for timing to give procurement a bit more runway, but we can aim to start the technical deep dive this week if Aditya is available.

Dependency note: procurement will need SOC2 and an estimated MRR/usage forecast to present to finance. Can you include a section with a 3-month pilot forecast?

I can confirm procurement will review the SOW; likely two-week turnaround once we get the SOC2 docs.

Thanks — Caroline
